title: SI-Powered Detention Communications and Video Intelligence Suite (RFI)
description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement requests information on an integrated SI-powered detention communications and video intelligence suite, including software licenses and subscriptions, implementation, integration, configuration, testing, training, cybersecurity support, operations and maintenance, and transition services. RFI questions were due Oct 16, 2026. Responses are due Oct 26, 2026 at 09:00 ET via Microsoft Forms.
